name: Troll Witchery
summary: Brother Nimetz sends you into Skullsplitter territory to learn what has corrupted Colonel Kurzen. After Kurzen's Mystery, he asks you to gather fetishes from the tribe's spellcasters.

sections.title: Unraveling the Corruption
sections.body: Brother Nimetz suspects dark troll magic lies behind Colonel Kurzen's fall into evil. Legends recovered from the jungle have led him to the second troll tribe farther south. So he asks you to enter Skullsplitter lands and take fetishes from their Witch Doctors and Mystics. He will study the magic they carry at the Rebel Camp.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Troll Witchery?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz gives Troll Witchery at the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why does Brother Nimetz want Skullsplitter fetishes?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz wants to study the dark magical implements and learn whether troll witchcraft explains Colonel Kurzen's fall into evil.
Skullsplitter Witch Doctors and Skullsplitter Mystics carry fetishes in Skullsplitter territory.
Troll Witchery follows Kurzen's Mystery and continues Brother Nimetz's investigation into the colonel's madness.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can help Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp uncover what corrupted Colonel Kurzen.
